description: This file defines a class for configuring and handling audio transcription requests and responses specifically for OpenAI's Whisper models. It includes methods for URL construction, parameter validation and mapping, environment validation, request transformation, error handling, and response parsing.

classes.name: OpenAIWhisperAudioTranscriptionConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for handling OpenAI Whisper audio transcription requests, responses, and associated environment validation.
